title: Report UI fails axe: 21 color-contrast nodes and an empty table header
symptom: The report UI fails axe in e2e: color-contrast on 21 nodes (light-mode Tailwind classes — text-blue-700 links, text-amber-800, amber-50 panel — placed on the shared dark theme where they drop below contrast ratio) and empty-table-header on the findings table's detail column (<th aria-label=... with no text content).
regression_test: playwright e2e: frontend/tests/e2e/core-journey.spec.ts axe checks on /, /findings/f-01/, /rules/
root_cause: Report pages used light-mode palette classes instead of the shared token colors designed for the dark theme; the trailing table header was left textless.
bench_note: Style-only fix to token colors; e2e axe check is the regression gate.
notes: Found by the repo's own e2e axe gate on first run.
